summary: Backend verification of dynamic site logo across all email templates (bug fix). All 14 tests passed: GET list, GET single (6 templates), POST preview (6 templates), and a dynamic-update test that mutates admin site logo and confirms the preview reflects the change (with cleanup). No template contains the legacy 'gingerkare-logo-3-blue.png' URL and no {{site_logo}} placeholder leaks. Logos returned equal current admin_settings type='site' logo_url from GET /api/settings/site.
critical_code_review_comments: email_templates.py: DEFAULT_SITE_LOGO fallback still points to the legacy gingerkare URL. If admin_settings has no 'site' doc or missing logo_url, the legacy logo would resurface. Consider using an empty string or a neutral placeholder as the fallback.

apply_site_logo only replaces the exact OLD_HARDCODED_LOGO string. If a customized template stored in DB contains a different legacy URL variant, it will remain. Consider a broader img-src regex substitution for stored custom templates.
